name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause 2 uses RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box), which only requires holding_box sometime before or after reaching the exit. The task states that you must be carrying the box at the moment you reach the exit, so the clause should be a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) (or an equivalent hard requirement that holding_box holds when at_exit is true). Replace the RespondedExistence clause with a hard Response clause.
